explore-keying.title: Clean up the CW
explore-keying.prompt: This CW signal chirps and clicks. Fix both faults.
hints: Chirp comes from the supply voltage dipping on every key-down.
Clicks come from switching the carrier on and off too sharply.
explore-keying.success: A regulated supply stops the chirp, and shaped keying edges stop the clicks.

explore-am.title: Compare AM and SSB
explore-am.prompt: Switch to AM. How much wider is it than SSB?
explore-am.success: AM is 6 kHz wide: a carrier plus two 3 kHz sidebands. SSB sends just one sideband.
